snippet.title: Deck and Conn – Official Reveal Trailer | Published by MicroProse
snippet.description:
Take command of a Cold War–era nuclear corvette… in space. 🛰️
Deck and Conn is a retro-inspired tactical strategy game blending pixel-art style with deep resource management, branching campaigns, and tense encounters. Inspired by classics like Super Star Trek, it brings a fresh but nostalgic twist to space command.
⚓ Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3828500/Deck__Conn/
